messages:
emma_sales: quick ask  HaloHealth (regional hospital network) requesting a one-time custom term. They want 29% off Dedicated list for year1 + onboarding fee waived. Also asking for Net75 due to grant timing. Need deal desk + finance guidance by EOW.

lucas_dealdesk: Can you share TCV and expansion signal? Any precedent for Net75 in healthcare? Not seeing in playbook.

emma_sales: Proposed TCV at discounted = $498k (list ~$702k). Upside: statewide rollout potential Y2 (~$1.6M). Theyre offering a named case study and C-level intro if we accept terms.

marta_finance: Quick calc:
```
List: $702,000
Proposed: $498,420
Discount: 29%
Est. contribution margin: ~18%
```
Finance is cautious on Net75. We can consider the discount if we get offsets.

kevin_revops: Ops note: if onboarding fee waived we need service credits or a milestone to cover onboarding labor. Also need SKU mapping for Dedicated + Private in billing.

olivia_legal: Legal needs to see exact SOW lines to convert fee to credits. Also will require an expansion-clawback clause and a definition of "case study" (timing/approval) before we promise public reference.

emma_sales: Customer says Net75 is non-negotiable because of grant disbursement schedule. They can provide PO now and award letter later. No upfront cash available.

lucas_dealdesk: Counterproposal: accept PO + award letter within 30 days, convert onboarding fee to a $45k service credit applied over first 6 invoices, and require a 12-month expansion milestone with partial rebate clawback if unmet. If customer can't provide award letter in 30 days, we revert to Net60 and 15% non-refundable up front.

marta_finance: Finance provisional OK on 29% + credits if conditions met: (1) signed PO before provisioning, (2) award letter or proof of funds within 30 days, (3) explicit no-stacking with other promos, (4) clawback math in contract. Will not approve Net75 without proof; Net60 preferred.

kevin_revops: Please add a metering SLA and alert thresholds for onboarding so billing can apply credits correctly. Also add playbook owner for the rollout.

olivia_legal: I'll draft the amendment with credit schedule, award-proof clause, expansion-clawback formula, and case study language. Need SOW lines and the customer's procurement contact.

billing-bot: Draft invoice template created: /invoices/templates/halohealth_customterm_v1.docx

emma_sales: I'll push procurement for PO and get the award letter. Posting SOW lines and procurement contact to @olivia_legal now. Thanks everyone. :pray:

lucas_dealdesk: Marking provisional approval pending PO + award letter + signed amendment. Escalate to VP Sales if procurement refuses award letter or demands unconditional waiver. :thumbsup:
